title: Pregnant Blend 4-Mix Duo #08 (세로 띠·매끈 / 동심원·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Japanese, in her late 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a bright, giddy grin, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in braided, real pores, real living eyes, 5 segment rings piercings set with amethysts in bronze-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold a bracelet. Painted in 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 21% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 46% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 72% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), wide gold-leaf bands following the contours of the body, with eggshell-white scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder), wide gold-powder bands following the contours of the body, with gold powder glittering densely filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, with geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with folk-art florals filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Jamaican, in her early 30s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in wavy, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with amethysts in brass-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold a necklace. Painted in 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 41% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 41%, 69% and 84% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with morphing tessellation filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), wide gold-and-silver bands following the contours of the body, with geometric star inlay filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following the contours of the body, with spiral floral bands filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both arms raised overhead framing her silhouette, belly and bust both fully displayed, confident direct gaze, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
